annotation.title_clean: 商务部等6部门关于更好服务实体经济 推进电子商务高质量发展的指导意见
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions of Six Departments Including the Ministry of Commerce on Better Serving the Real Economy and Promoting High-Quality Development of E-Commerce
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部; 中央网信办; 工业和信息化部; 农业农村部; 文化和旅游部; 市场监管总局
annotation.summary_en: March 2026 guidance from six Chinese departments on high-quality e-commerce development. It covers SME digitalisation, rural and industrial e-commerce, cross-border trade, platform responsibility, regulation and data. AI appears only briefly ("AI+e-commerce", large models, algorithm rules); no robotics provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Promote 'AI+e-commerce' and large-model applications; encourage technology for good and balanced algorithm rules
Strengthen platform responsibility, including data security and redress mechanisms for merchants
Align rules on personal information protection and cross-border data flows; pursue CPTPP and DEPA accession
Develop cross-border e-commerce and Silk Road e-commerce cooperation
Strengthen routine supervision, including live-stream commerce compliance guidelines and antitrust enforcement
